verdict.rationale: Notte's own docs describe generating workflow code from agent or CLI runs, editing it, and deploying it as serverless functions. Its GitHub page pitches a hybrid model: script the deterministic parts and use AI only when needed, cutting costs by 50%+. Together these roughly deliver replayable generated code at lower cost than re-prompting, but there is no explicit caching layer for resolved actions. Missing for 10: a documented automatic action/selector cache, explicit agent-run-to-script replay mechanics, independent or hands-on corroboration of the cost and latency savings.
